user_saw: If the system clock jumped during ChatGPT device-code sign-in, the login could time out early or keep waiting past 15 minutes.
summary: The fix uses a monotonic clock for the 15-minute device-code polling deadline and its remaining budget.
reasoning: The July 1 snapshot already seeded and checked the deadline with Date.now() and used the remaining wall-clock budget to schedule polling with setTimeout. PR #109494 reused that budget to cap individual requests, so the same clock-jump failure was possible before that change. Local history stopped at the shallow boundary, leaving it unclear whether the original device-code flow shipped with the defect or an earlier change introduced it.
